usedFor: BlueyEmail runs campaigns and forms, and Slack tells the team through “Send Message” when “When a form is submitted” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “When a form is submitted” in BlueyEmail, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team hears about a new form response in a channel while the lead is still warm.

watchOut: A Slack post from an automation waits for approval today, so “Send Message” posts after you approve.
